title: Fatigue assessment
summary: Fatigue of components under loads acting in several directions. I develop and compare critical plane methods that link local stresses and strains to fatigue life, for notched and welded components.
methods: Analytical and semi-analytical models; finite element post-processing; comparison with fatigue tests.

title: Welded structures and residual stresses
summary: Welding leaves residual stresses before a part enters service. I study how they combine with applied loads and affect fatigue life, through simulations and measurements.
methods: Thermal–structural finite element analysis; residual stress evaluation; experimental fatigue testing.

title: Additive manufacturing
summary: Mechanical behaviour of additively manufactured structures and thermal effects of the process, from representative structure elements to analytical models of welding and metal additive manufacturing.
methods: Analytical heat-flow models; finite element analysis; experimental characterisation.

title: Materials and component testing
summary: Static, cyclic and temperature-dependent response of materials, joints and components: polymer composites, hybrid riveted joints, automotive parts and circuit board assemblies.
methods: Static and fatigue tests; strain, vibration and temperature measurements; computational modelling.
